newsitem.title: POLAND: Universal to plans 2.3 mln ADR issue.
newsitem.headline: Universal to plans 2.3 mln ADR issue.

text.p: The Polish trading company Universal SA applied to the Polish Securities Commission (KPW) for a permission to issue up to 2,260,051 American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), the company said in a statement.
It said one ADR would represent one share and they would start trade three to six months after it is cleared by the KPW.
It said the Bank of New York would be the depository bank and the transfer agent of the receipts.
"The receipts issue abroad will pave the way to international capital markets," Universal said.
Universal said the maximum number of shares which would be covered by the ADR programme would represent about 9.6 percent of the total outstanding shares.
It also said the ADR issue, likely to be taken up by passive investors, should reduce high liquidity of the company's stock on the Warsaw market and possibly positively affect its price.
